rules: One entry per vocabulary genre (a Discogs genre or an extra); the 11 families themselves are level 1 and not listed (the top-level 'families' block holds their synonyms). Every node below a family is a genre (ADR-0030).

parents: a non-empty list of unique names, each a family (level 1 name) or the key of another entry. parents[0] is the primary parent: it decides the level (2 when it is a family, else 1 + the level of that parent; hard cap three levels), the family (the family of parents[0]) and the default outline position. Further entries are extra parents, drawn as cross-links (an extra parent that is a family lists the genre in that family's tree too). Validation: every parent resolves, parents are unique, no cycle through any parent (so an extra parent is never a descendant), no level 4.

family: optional override, only for a level 3 genre whose primary parent sits in several families (disco is in Funk / Soul and Electronic): it names which of those families the genre belongs to. It must be one of them.
provisional: true marks an undrafted placeholder (all families except Electronic); parents is just the family.
discogs: true when the key is in genre_discogs.json, false when it exists only in genre_extras.json.

families: family name plus lowercase synonyms; genre entries may carry an optional synonyms list (carried over from ALIASES in genre_filter.py, read-only). A synonym never equals a vocabulary key, a family name or another synonym; typos are input normalisation, not synonyms.
flavours: optional list of keys of the top-level 'flavours' block ({name, kind sound|scene, description}); a modifier alongside the tree, not a level. Only Electronic entries carry them so far.
status: optional 'approved' (Alex approved; only on entries with discogs false, because Discogs outranks his approval) or 'question' (under question, any entry); absent means unreviewed.
display: optional display name of a genre (default: the key); never equal, when lowercased, to another vocabulary key.
